adoption.text: evidence: stages of 224 fresh paired games up to 896; adopt when the lower bound of the paired gain is above 1 point with at least 200 games, reject when the upper bound is below it, otherwise could not tell; a nominee with no gain after 2 stages (448 games) stops early as could not tell; α = 0.05 spent over 4 looks (O'Brien–Fleming-type, z = 4.33 / 2.96 / 2.36 / 2.01); change ledger on: a nominee with held-out games from earlier runs (same simulator version, bot and field) is judged on those games first, then on them and each new stage pooled, by an always-valid boundary (normal mixture, Howard et al. 2021, ρ = 250 games, one-sided 0.025 each: z = 3.32 at 448 games, 3.11 at 896, 3.04 at 1,792, 3.06 at 3,584); screened with the Medium bot, confirmed with the Hard bot
